COMPOUND QUERY
  LEFT-MOST SUBQUERY
    CO-ROUTINE q
      SCAN n CONSTANT ROWS
    SCAN q
    SEARCH l USING PRIMARY KEY (target_kind=? AND ref_id=? AND session_id=? AND lane=?)
  UNION ALL
    CO-ROUTINE w
      SCAN n CONSTANT ROWS
    SCAN w
    SEARCH l USING PRIMARY KEY (target_kind=? AND ref_id=? AND session_id=? AND lane=? AND record_id=?)
    CORRELATED LIST SUBQUERY n
      SEARCH n USING COVERING INDEX direction_live_newest (target_kind=? AND ref_id=? AND session_id=? AND lane=? AND reach=? AND written_at>?)
